target_year_over_year_context.explanation:
Both disclosures focus on cloud service providers (CSPs) and consumer internet companies using NVIDIA's accelerated computing platforms to deliver end-user services like search, AI assistants, and social networking.

Both disclosures detail how enterprises and startups across industries (transportation, healthcare, financial services) use NVIDIA platforms for automation, AI assistants, autonomous driving, drug discovery, and fraud detection.

Both disclosures describe the use of NVIDIA GPUs and software by professional artists, architects, and designers for creative work such as visual effects, movie production, and product/building design.

comparisons.peer_summary: The AMD Radeon PRO family provides professional graphics products optimized for demanding use cases such as 3D rendering, CAD, and media/entertainment pipelines on high-resolution displays.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVIDIA and AMD disclose their strategies regarding professional graphics workstations. NVIDIA highlights that generative AI is expanding the market for workstation-class GPUs as enterprises deploy AI applications on-premises, citing professional artists and designers using their products for creative and design use cases. Similarly, AMD describes its Radeon PRO family as professional graphics products optimized for demanding use cases such as 3D rendering, CAD, and media/entertainment pipelines. While both focus on the professional workstation segment involving creative and design applications, NVIDIA explicitly links this growth to the expansion of generative AI workloads on-premises, whereas AMD emphasizes optimization for specific industrial and entertainment pipelines like CAD and broadcast.

sentences.text: Professional artists, architects and designers use NVIDIA partner products accelerated with our GPUs and software platform for a range of creative and design use cases, such as creating visual effects in movies or designing buildings and products.
In addition, generative AI is expanding the market for our workstation-class GPUs, as more enterprise customers develop and deploy AI applications with their data on-premises.

Our AMD Radeon PRO family of professional graphics products are designed for integration in desktop workstations, optimized through hardware and software for demanding use cases such as 3D rendering, design and manufacturing for Computer-Aided Design (CAD), and media and entertainment for broadcast and animation pipelines on high resolution displays.
